company.name: Khayal Studio
company.shortDescription: Khayal Studio is a digital content development studio in Cairo, Egypt, specialised in VR/AR applications, like ArcViz, Education, & Games.
company.description:
Khayal Studio is a software development company committed to deliver stunning AR/VR solutions and content, enriching customers’ experiences by entertainment. The company believes in the Philosophy of “Winning the audience soul attention needs Engagement, engagement need Entertainment”.

This philosophy is the core of Khayal’s business committed to equip its partners with variety of solutions to engage their target audience, whether these audience are internal employees, visitors, guests, or prospective customers or buyers.

Khayal established in 2016 by high-end professionals experienced in IT and Telecom industry focusing to make use of new technologies, techniques, concepts, and tools to achieve the company’s vision.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $25,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $392,872 to $392,872, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 17 (-34).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
